full_judgment: 9. The learned advocate for the complainant-opposite party faintly sought to argue that the second revisional application before Addl. Sessions Judge was barred by limitation. That question is not at all important now since this court has already called for the records of this case and once this matter has come to the notice of this court which touches the question of jurisdiction of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate to pass the impugned order, it must be struck down as it has already been found that the learned Magistrate acted wholly without jurisdiction in summoning the petitioners Nos. 2-7.
